param.label: FASTA of the sequence you are looking for
param.help: A vector, transgene or viral genome. The unmapped reads are matched against it directly, so no classifier and no classifier database are needed.

param.label: Taxonomy ID to report the donor under
param.help: Left empty, the sites are reported under 32630, NCBI's synthetic construct. Set it to the real taxid if the donor is a natural genome rather than a construct.
